# Online experiments

Online studies can make it possible to recruit and test participants remotely, but require careful attention to participant experience, data quality, privacy, and technical compatibility.

## Before building a study

- Confirm ethics approval covers the platform, recruitment, and data collected.
- Choose the institutionally approved survey or experiment platform.
- Test the study on supported browsers and screen sizes.
- Make consent, withdrawal, and contact information clear to participants.
- Plan exclusion and quality checks before collecting data.
